reviews.comment: He gives a lot of homework and the lecture slides don't really have enough content to be able to do them, so you have to resort to chegg a lot. Besides that, his tests are fine if you have access to previous ones. There's a big pointless project too, it involves counting cars and writing a report about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: It was one of the best classes I ever attended. Very engaging. Yes! he is old school, he will push you to your limits (we had 4 tests, 10 homework assignments, and one group project). He is very straightforward with his comments. I would recommend this course if you plan to pursue a career in transportation engineering field.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Old school guy. Attendance is required. Regular hw that is very useful for his exams. Class is a lot of work, but you learn a ton. He is an excellent lecturer, never boring. He talks very loudly. Take a class with him if you truly want to learn the subject. It's not an easy A, but it is attainable if you put in the work. Fair professor, good person
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Hawkins class is very straight forward and all the HW and exams are reasonable. You can tell that he cares about the success of his students. He is sometimes funny, he likes to show videos before class, and he is a loud person. He does random attendance checks and gets really upset when students walk in late.
Lots of Material covered in the class
